_comment: The FIGHT leg of the 3-path mage-consult parity (cisterns_fight/talk/scout precedent -- three SEPARATE scripts, not one combined 'door_chain_paths', matching that precedent exactly and justified the same way: each leg's route/assertions differ enough that a single script would need multiple fixture re-installs mid-run for no real coverage gain). This is the FLAGSHIP end-to-end script: it runs the FIGHT leg of the mage consult (Pisces sends the player to clear rift_vermin_leak in the inn), then the FULL ruin run (ruin trip -> ruin_guardian fight -> anchor_stone_pedestal opens -> Krshia's resonant_catalyst purchase), ending with the chain's `consult` and `buy_catalyst` beats complete and the quest sitting on its third and last beat, `attune` -- door_that_goes_elsewhere completes only at the door's awakening (door_awakened), door_awakening.json's subject, NOT at the catalyst purchase. The anchor stone still comes up at the pedestal here but no longer completes any beat of this quest: the 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure moved the retrieval into its own quest (`horns_dig`) and deleted the old `recover_stone` beat. Erin's old beat-1 flicker start is gone from this script; Task 2.4 replaced it with the chain's REAL start, the pantry MOUNTING scene, played live from the first step -- see that step's own comment. door_chain_talk/door_chain_scout (door_chain_started pre-banked in their fixtures, same as this one now) cover the other two consult legs plus a partial slice of the recovery beat each (talk proves the pedestal's OR-gate opens WITHOUT fighting the guardian; scout proves the catalyst purchase again from a different angle) -- together the three scripts cover door_understood parity, the pedestal's contains_when OR-gate from both a FIGHT and a non-FIGHT producer, and the full quest completion, without triple-deriving the whole chain three times. Uses `teleport` for every inter-map hop (real navigation across inn/street/floodplains/ruin_surface is ALREADY proven live by inn_walkthrough/gate_district_walkthrough/tutorial_flow/ruin_walkthrough -- this script's subject is the consult-path/combat/container/purchase wiring, not pathing; the arc_flow/deep_descent precedent for teleporting past an already-proven stretch). Every teleport lands one cell short of its target, followed by a `move` INTO the target (sets facing even when blocked, wi_game.gd move_player's unconditional `player_facing = dir` before the blocked check) before interact.
